concepts.label: te-node
concepts.gloss: A te-node is a network element that forms a node in the te-topology and hosts termination points.

concepts.label: termination-point
concepts.gloss: A termination-point on a te-node that terminates a te-link.

concepts.label: supporting-tp
concepts.gloss: A supporting termination that provides cross-layer adaptation for a corresponding termination, enabling transport-to-service mapping.
concepts.example: OTN tp over optical tp at R1
instances: OTN tp over optical tp at R1

concepts.label: tunnel-termination-point
concepts.gloss: A tunnel-termination-point is a termination on a te-node that represents the tunnel head and originates a tunnel.

concepts.label: te-tunnel
concepts.gloss: A te-tunnel is a service that carries traffic from tunnel termination points across the te-topology.

concepts.label: otn-label
concepts.gloss: An OTN label (multiplex) that labels a te-tunnel to multiplex traffic within an OTU/TS/TPN context.

concepts.label: connectivity-matrix
concepts.gloss: A connectivity matrix on a te-node that defines how its termination points are interconnected (switching).

concepts.label: te-link
concepts.gloss: A te-link that connects te-nodes and is terminated by termination-points at its ends.

concepts.label: te-topology
concepts.gloss: A te-topology is the collection of te-nodes and te-links that make up the OTN layer network.

concepts.label: tunnel-connection-endpoint
concepts.gloss: A tunnel connection endpoint is an endpoint on a te-node that is part of a tunnel connection.
